messages:
jess: Heads up — seeing a consistent invoice delta spike tied to short retry bursts from the router this morning. Thinking about a lightweight ingest debounce (200–500ms) to collapse retries before metering. Anyone remember why we avoided debounce earlier? :thinking:
kevin: We punted because it hides legitimate rapid-fire requests from batchy clients. Also worried about messing with SLA math for low-latency apps. But for retries from the same route fingerprint it seems safe.
sophia: Can we instead dedupe only for identical fingerprint + client_id within X ms? That keeps valid bursts intact. Also need to surface "billing duplicate rate" in the console before rolling out. Product wants visibility.
jess: Agree on scoped dedupe (fingerprint + client). My proposal: ingest-side dedupe window = 300ms behind a feature flag; emit a `metering.deduped` tag on the event so downstream can choose to invoice or not.
oliver: What about replay/backfill implications? If we mark as deduped we'll drop events forever unless we keep raw logs. We should add a `dedup_reason` field and forward raw event to cold storage for audits.
kevin: Quick skim of example event flow that caused the spike (sanitized):
```
{"client_id":"acct_42","req_id":"r_9b3","routing_key":"proxy-fallback","tokens":120,"fingerprint":"fp_aa12","ts":"2026-03-19T15:02:10Z"}
{"client_id":"acct_42","req_id":"r_9b3_retry1","routing_key":"proxy-fallback","tokens":120,"fingerprint":"fp_aa12","ts":"2026-03-19T15:02:10Z"}
```
kevin: Two events 40ms apart, same fingerprint. Metering double-billed 240 tokens for a short client-side retry.
sophia: Console UX: We should add a small alert card on billing dashboard: "Suspected duplicate billing events" with toggle to include/exclude deduped tokens in invoice preview. That'll help support and finance triage.
jess: Ops plan: feature flag controlled rollout, canary on 10% of ingestion nodes -> watch `metering.delta` and `billing.invoice_delta` in Splunk/Kibana. If delta drops to normal and no customer complaints, ramp. Add canary A/B to console so finance sees both views.
oliver: Dev note: implement dedupe as a sharded in-memory LRU keyed by `client_id|fingerprint` with timestamp. Keep TTL = 1s to limit memory. Emit metrics: `dedupe.hits`, `dedupe.evictions`.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary-policy applied to ingestion-service:v3.4.2 -> 2 nodes (canary) at 2026-03-19T16:10:00Z :rocket:
kevin: One more edge: what about embeddings/long streaming calls that send partial tokens? fingerprint might be identical but tokens differ. We should only dedupe if `tokens` match or `is_retry=true` header present.
sophia: Good call. Add UI option: "Treat partial streams as unique" default ON.
jess: Action items:
- kevin: prototype ingest dedupe lib + add `metering.deduped` tag (ETA EOD)
- oliver: cold-storage raw event forwarding + audit doc (ETA tomorrow)
- sophia: mock console card + toggle for finance (ETA Tues)
- me: feature-flagged canary + telemetry dashboards to monitor invoice deltas (ETA Tues midday)
kevin: I'll post a short PR with the event sample and tests, pinging @jess for review. :thumbsup:
jess: Thanks — let's keep the canary tight and loop in finance before ramp.
kevin: ack.
